mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's tightening response leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
